meetSection.title: Our Blessed Journey
meetSection.sectionHeading: In The Light of Allah's Blessings
meetSection.bio: With the grace of Almighty Allah and the heartfelt blessings of our loving parents, Mr. & Mrs. Mohammed Mansoor and Mr. & Mrs. Abdul Rahim, we unite our lives in marriage. Two hearts embarking on one shared lifelong journey. We cordially invite you and your family to grace our celebration and bless our union.

messageSection.title: Your Presence Is Our Blessing
messageSection.paragraph1: Your presence will make our auspicious day truly memorable and complete.
messageSection.paragraph2: We warmly await the honor of your company as we commence this chapter of our lives at Adams Mahal, Karaikudi.

countdownSection.message: Counting down the days to our blessed wedding celebration!

thingsToKnow.title: Things to Know
thingsToKnow.description: Essential event information for our cherished guests attending the wedding.
thingsToKnow.surpriseMessage: Your warm presence and prayers are the greatest gift to us!

tips.title: Venue & Parking
tips.text: The wedding will take place at Adams Mahal, Anada Nagar, Karaikudi. Ample parking facilities are arranged for all guests.

tips.title: Wedding Hashtag
tips.text: Capture and celebrate the joyous moments with us on social media using #YasarWedsAyisha
